notes.title: Demo Update: Electric Dogfights🛩️
notes.content:
[h1]This is a big one[/h1]
Alright, we are back with a new update. We've completely redesigned combat to provide more intense dogfight-style action and added some new electrifying run upgrades. Plus, we've added a new store that appears every 5 waves, giving you a chance to catch your breath, buy some health, and strengthen your pilot.

In this update, we also revamped the save system to enhance long-term gameplay, particularly regarding perks. Unfortunately, this means that any perks you've already unlocked will be reset. We understand this can be frustrating, but we hope you appreciate that such changes are sometimes necessary in an experimental demo. If you have any concerns, please share your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/A8SXTaE6P6]Discord channel[/url].

Alright, now for the changes:

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new run store that appears every 5th wave, where you can heal or upgrade your ship's power.
[*] Added new upgrade: Chain Lightning
[*] Added new upgrade: Thunder Dash
[*] Added new upgrade: Tesla Coil
[*] Added dogfight-like behavior to some enemies.
[*] Added windup and muzzle flash to enemies to improve clarity when they are attacking.
[*] Kamikaze enemies now explode upon attacking and impacting the player.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Zara’s max health and added an Increase Max Health perk to this pilot.
[*] Removed the health regen perk from both pilots.
[*] Displayed green color for positive changes and red color for negative changes in the UI.
[*] Run upgrades now have a new random system, making it possible to get new types of upgrades further down a run.
[*] Deflected bullets no longer deflect other bullets.
[*] Disabled Endless mode for now; it will be activated again soon.
[*] The Deflect Air Mine upgrade reduces the size of the mine on the first upgrade.
[*] Nerfed the Improved Dash upgrade on Striker to compensate for the Run Store upgrade.
[*] Nerfed the Life Steal upgrade; it now reduces your max life to 50% of its value the first time you apply it.
[*] Nerfed the Health Regen upgrade; it now only regenerates when you are under 25% health.
[*] Reduced the chance of Life Steal and Health Regen upgrades appearing.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Deflect Air mine upgrade now display correct values.
[*] Fixed bug with Time Ghost being able to drop more air mines than the player did.
[*] Fixed issue with the camera getting stuck in a zoomed-out state when rewinding.
[*] Fixed issue with enemies sometimes disappearing when playing with Zara.
[*] Fixed issue with perks refunding not working properly.
[*] Fixed issue with rewinding between waves breaking wave spawning.
[*] Prevented hover tooltip from triggering multiple times in the pilot select screen for some screens.
[*] Reduced ghost playback stuttering.
[/list]

And a bunch of other things under the hood. But that's the gist of it.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts on the new combat mechanics and store features. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us make RogueSky the best it can be. 🛩️

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes: Striker Enhancements and Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new Air Roll cooldown perk to Striker.
[*] Changed the default special ability button for gamepads.
[*] Modified joystick input to binary for player rotation.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes & Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the cost to unlock Striker.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would go too far underwater when firing.
[*] Resolved a problem with controller icons not displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed missing text in Chinese and Japanese versions.
[*] Addressed an issue where the pause screen was not functioning correctly in endless mode.
[*] Prevented the player from taking damage from colliders outside the screen.
[*] Adjusted the water and sky boundary for better readability.
[*] Corrected the incorrect description for the Spearhead Mine upgrade.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes: Enhanced Gameplay, Balance, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed wave timer and stackable waves.
[*] Added a sound that plays when the player levels up.
[*] Added a shockwave that knocks back enemies when the player levels up.
[*] Upgrade window is now automatically shown instead of needing to press Q.
[*] Improved visibility for player in the water.
[*] Increased how much of the water you can see.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Key rebinds now automatically load when opening the game again.
[*] Perk cost text now correctly shows the right amount when maxed out.
[*] Striker's shield always starts at the correct strength.
[*] Removed stutter when the second part of the gameplay song starts.
[*] Addressed various minor issues.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased Zara's bullet size.
[*] Made the first waves easier to assist with onboarding new players.
[*] Increased the XP pickup range area. Nerfed XP magnet accordingly.
[/list]
